root_cause: The existing semantic personal LinkedIn gate still retained an exact-content business exception and did not require a machine-readable personal_life_only/business_bridge source contract, leaving a path for business topics to enter a personal-profile candidate before final-copy rejection.
prevention: Personal LinkedIn is personal-life-only with no business exception.
Require personal_life_only=true and business_bridge=false at source eligibility.
Inspect final text independently and block all business/company/consultancy/organizational signals.
Route business themes to linkedin_company; never disguise them as personal anecdotes.
Keep personal-profile learning separate from company/commercial ranking.
